headline: 厄文威爾許新作獲好評
context: 蘇格蘭作家厄文・威爾許（Irvine Welsh）推出新作《Can Nothing Save Us?》，描寫美國家庭在世代觀念分裂下的衝突，被譽為他晚期創作的代表作之一。Netflix改編1901年小說《我的璀璨事業》（My Brilliant Career），由菲莉帕・諾斯伊斯特（Phillipa Northeast）主演，獲得好評。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The Scottish author focuses on gun culture and generational conflict in this darkly satirical tale about a great power in decline “Why expect unconditional love from somebody you’ve brought into a fucked, dying planet, who then has to sit around and watch you screw it up even more?” So muses twentysomething college dropout Luke Ayrton on his parental lineage as he works the Las Vegas Strip, “comping girls for clubs” in Sin City. His job is to trawl the “plankton” of bacherlorette parties in order to lure the “whales” – rich men willing to spend to try to impress young women. “In this game your sociology skills sharpened,” it’s observed, but beyond the seedy side hustle lie weightier concerns: the matter of his family legacy. Electronic dance music aficionado and aspiring writer Luke is estranged from his Maga-positive Mom and Dad, and now lives with grandparents George and Molly, affluent boomers with a countercultural past. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Phillipa Northeast is brilliant as a young woman rebelling against society’s expectations in 1890s Australia. It is witty, intelligent and absolutely glorious to watch “I’m hot headed, with a snub nose, and that’s why I prefer a direct gaze.” So speaks Sybylla, the charmingly irrepressible and irrepressibly charming heroine of My Brilliant Career, played utterly convincingly and with vim, vigour and joy by Philippa Northeast in the new adaptation of Miles Franklin’s 1901 Australian classic of the same name. Creator Liz Doran must have wept with happiness when they found an actor capable of bringing so much to an already glorious script – and who embodies the joie de vivre upon which so much of the plot, as everyone she meets becomes part of her orbit, depends. thread_text:
蘇格蘭作家厄文・威爾許（Irvine Welsh）推出新作《Can Nothing Save Us?》。故事主角路克・艾爾頓（Luke Ayrton），是拉斯維加斯大道上的夜店拉客員，與支持川普的父母疏遠，如今與有反文化背景的祖父母同住，這部小說被譽為他晚期創作的代表作。

Netflix改編米爾斯・富蘭克林（Miles Franklin）1901年小說《我的璀璨事業》（My Brilliant Career），菲莉帕・諾斯伊斯特（Phillipa Northeast）飾演反抗傳統框架的女主角西比拉（Sybylla），獲得好評。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 13 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
